task: Fix compaction-summary conversion in cortexterm/anthropic_adapter.py. After compaction, a retained suffix may start with assistant tool_use. The current converter places the older conversation summary in the system prompt, leaving no user context before that suffix. Represent marked summaries as user conversation context, including legacy checkpoints whose internal role is system. Keep the real system prompt separate, preserve tool-use/result pairs, and enclose summary text in <summary> newline ... newline </summary>. Use the existing conversion conventions and keep existing tests passing.
history: Provider-boundary lesson: isCompactionSummary describes the semantic meaning of a checkpoint; check it before ordinary role dispatch. Internal storage roles need not equal API roles. The system prompt must contain instructions, not a summary of user/assistant history. A summary replaces old conversational turns, so convert it to a user text block. Reuse _push_anthropic_message to merge adjacent same-role blocks without losing tool IDs.
